note: Roles are frozen before any run. Changing a role after seeing results turns an exploratory finding into a confirmatory claim it never was.

encode_ccre.description: ENCODE registry of candidate cis-regulatory elements, GRCh38, aggregated over all biosamples
encode_ccre.class_column_note: Column 10 (1-based) holds comma-separated labels, e.g. 'pELS,CTCF-bound'. The default class column in read_ccre_bed is 5 and is wrong for this file; pass --class-column 9.

gencode_gtf.description: GENCODE basic annotation: one representative transcript set, which avoids inflating splice-site counts with rare isoforms

genome_fasta.description: GRCh38 primary assembly, used for GC content and for the N runs excluded at window selection

concepts.name: cCRE_PLS
concepts.question: Does a feature mark promoter-like regions?

concepts.name: cCRE_pELS
concepts.question: Does a feature mark proximal enhancer-like regions (within 2 kb of a TSS)?

concepts.name: cCRE_dELS
concepts.question: Does a feature mark distal enhancer-like regions (beyond 2 kb from a TSS)?
concepts.pairing_note: pELS and dELS come from the same experimental signal and differ only in distance to the nearest TSS. If their depth curves separate, that separation is about long-range position and nothing else.

concepts.name: cCRE_CTCF-only
concepts.question: Does a feature mark CTCF-bound sites without enhancer or promoter signal?

concepts.name: cCRE_DNase-H3K4me3
concepts.question: Does a feature mark accessible H3K4me3 sites that are not promoter-like?
concepts.power_note: Rarest class in the panel. With 200 test windows per fold this sits just under the target precision; report its interval and do not over-read a small difference.

concepts.name: cCRE_any
concepts.question: Does a feature mark regulatory elements in general, rather than one class?
concepts.purpose: Specificity control. A feature scoring as high here as on a single class is detecting accessible chromatin, not that class.

concepts.name: splice_donor
concepts.question: Does a feature mark 5' splice sites?

derivation.definition: Intron start on the + strand, intron end on the - strand, taken from consecutive exons of the same transcript. Interval is the site +/- flank_bp.

concepts.purpose: A 6-20 bp sequence motif. Should be recoverable at the conv taps and should not need the tower.

concepts.name: splice_acceptor
concepts.question: Does a feature mark 3' splice sites?

derivation.definition: Intron end on the + strand, intron start on the - strand. Interval is the site +/- flank_bp.

concepts.name: TSS_within_2kb
concepts.question: Is this bin close to a transcription start site?

derivation.definition: Transcript start on the + strand, transcript end on the - strand, extended by window_bp on both sides.

concepts.purpose: Distance to the nearest TSS is not available inside a 34 bp receptive field but is available inside a 1 Mb context. The cleanest separator between conv and tower in the panel.

concepts.name: GC_rich
concepts.question: Does the pipeline recover something the model certainly encodes?

derivation.definition: Bins whose GC fraction is in the top quartile of valid bins on the same chromosome. Bins containing any ambiguous base are excluded before the quantile is taken.

concepts.purpose: Must clear the null at every tap. If it does not, the fault is in the matching pipeline, not in the model.

concepts.name: shuffled_dELS
concepts.question: Does the pipeline call something significant when nothing is there?

derivation.definition: dELS intervals relocated uniformly at random within the same chromosome, keeping count and length and avoiding assembly gaps.

concepts.purpose: Must sit at the null ceiling. Anything above it means the mask or the metric is wrong.

not_included.repeat_families: RepeatMasker Alu/L1 would link directly to the transposable-element features in the reference study, but UCSC is a third source and its checksum could not be pinned from the published md5sum list. Add it as a separate, dated amendment if wanted.
not_included.ENCODE_blacklist: Intended as an artifact diagnostic rather than a concept. The portal search for annotation_type=blacklist returned nothing, so it is left out rather than guessed at.
not_included.cell_type_specific_cCREs: The per-biosample cCRE files (1522 of them) would allow a cell-type-specific arm. Out of scope here: AlphaGenome sees only sequence, so a cell-type-specific label is largely unpredictable from its input.

evaluation_rules.grid: All concepts are evaluated on the 128 bp bin grid. Features from finer taps are max-pooled up to that grid.
evaluation_rules.mask: Bins containing any ambiguous base are excluded at every stage, identically.
evaluation_rules.null: Circular shift within contiguous runs of bins on a chromosome, taking the maximum over the dictionary, matching the best-of-many statistic that is reported.
evaluation_rules.baseline: Every SAE AUROC is reported next to the same statistic on the tap's raw channels.
evaluation_rules.splits: Tuning may look at the dev split only. The test split is read once, after all choices are frozen.
evaluation_rules.uncertainty: Adjacent bins are not independent. Intervals come from a bootstrap over windows, not over bins.
